source_title: 실시간 던전 파티.... 분노의 흑마 ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
subtitle: 가시덩굴 구릉 목걸이 쌍입찰 대참사

cuts.speaker: 인간 흑마법사
cuts.dialogue: 가시덩굴 구릉 지능·주문력 목걸이를 징기님이요? 혹시 힐러셨어요?
cuts.visual_prompt: Sleek 3-to-3.5-head-ratio Korean gag webtoon style on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Over-the-shoulder medium shot from behind 인간 흑마법사 on the left, her grumpy red imp doll tucked under one arm while she points curiously with an open hand toward 언데드 성기사 on the lower right. On the lower right beneath open white space, 언데드 성기사 stands with her two-handed golden warhammer strapped on her back, casually holding a glowing purple-blue orb necklace near a minimal thorny skeleton boss bone pile on the floor. Floating curiously beside Human Warlock's shoulder is her ultra-cute round squishy floating purple Voidwalker with glowing starry lavender belly and golden wrist bracers, peeking at the glowing necklace.

equip_effects: 착용 효과: 모든 주문 및 효과로 입히는 피해와 치유량이 증가합니다.

cuts.speaker: 언데드 성기사
cuts.dialogue: 성기사도 주문력이랑 지능 필요하거든요. 다 쓰는 스탯이에요.
cuts.visual_prompt: Sleek 3-to-3.5-head-ratio Korean gag webtoon style on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Medium side-angle two-shot: on the right, 언데드 성기사 with her two-handed golden warhammer strapped across her back raises the glowing orb necklace casually with half-lidded deadpan eyes. On the left, 인간 흑마법사 stares with a tiny awkward sweat drop on her temple, both hands free as her staff stays strapped on her back and her red imp doll sits quietly at her feet. Hovering beside Human Warlock, her ultra-cute round squishy floating purple Voidwalker with glowing starry lavender belly and golden wrist bracers blinks awkwardly with a tiny sweat drop.

cuts.speaker: 인간 흑마법사
cuts.dialogue: 아하… 뭐 그럴 수 있죠! 오늘 던전 좋은 거 엄청 잘 뜨네요 ㅎㅎ
cuts.visual_prompt: Sleek 3-to-3.5-head-ratio Korean gag webtoon style on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Slightly low-angle two-shot: on the left, 인간 흑마법사 forces an overly bright, cheerful thumbs-up smile to smooth over the mood while her red imp doll clings to her side. On the right, 오크 전사 equipped with a single one-handed axe and a sturdy iron tower shield nods happily in anticipation of her own tank drop, with minimal thorny floor lines under their boots. Floating cheerfully beside Human Warlock, her ultra-cute round squishy floating purple Voidwalker with glowing starry lavender belly and golden wrist bracers raises a stubby golden-bracered arm in agreement.

cuts.speaker: 언데드 성기사
cuts.dialogue: 어, 전투력도 붙었네요? 이것도 징기 템이라 입찰할게요.
cuts.visual_prompt: Sleek 3-to-3.5-head-ratio Korean gag webtoon style on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background. High-angle looting scene over a minimal defeated stitched abomination scrap pile on the floor: on the lower right under open white space, 언데드 성기사 with her two-handed golden warhammer strapped on her back tosses a chunky 6-sided white-and-gold cube showing ONLY classic round dot pips, strictly ZERO digits, ZERO numbers, ZERO letters, while snatching a second bone-and-iron necklace. On the left, 오크 전사 clutching her one-handed axe and sturdy iron tower shield stares wide-eyed in disbelief.

cuts.speaker: 인간 흑마법사
cuts.dialogue: 아까 지능목 드셨잖아요! 체력·방숙 목걸이는 전탱님 주셔야죠!!
cuts.visual_prompt: Sleek 3-to-3.5-head-ratio Korean gag webtoon style on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Dynamic tilted close-up reaction shot: on the left, 인간 흑마법사 snaps out of her forced polite smile and leans forward yelling in comical fiery rage, hands clenched in the air while her red imp doll jumps in shock at her feet. On the far right edge, 언데드 성기사 stands completely unfazed with sleepy eyes and her warhammer on her back. Floating beside Human Warlock, her ultra-cute round squishy floating purple Voidwalker with glowing starry lavender belly and golden wrist bracers puffs up indignantly mirroring her fiery comic rage.

Sleek 3-to-3.5-head-ratio Korean gag webtoon style on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Wordless deadpan freeze-frame two-shot: on the right, 언데드 성기사 with her two-handed warhammer strapped on her back calmly equips BOTH the glowing purple-blue orb necklace and the bone-and-iron necklace stacked around her neck with faint comedic sparkles and zero guilt. On the left, 인간 흑마법사 stands utterly frozen with shocked blank white eyes, stiff arms, and her red imp doll fainted flat on the floor beside her. Floating beside Human Warlock, her ultra-cute round squishy floating purple Voidwalker with glowing starry lavender belly and golden wrist bracers freezes wide-eyed in utter speechlessness.

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue: 저기… 그럼 방패 든 탱커인 제 목걸이는요…?
cuts.visual_prompt: Sleek 3-to-3.5-head-ratio Korean gag webtoon style on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Slightly pulled-back three-quarter aftermath shot: on the left, 오크 전사 with her one-handed axe and heavy iron tower shield slumps her shoulders helplessly, looking down at her bare neck with a pitiful expression. On the right, 인간 흑마법사 rubs her forehead in sheer exhaustion with one hand while her red imp doll sits slumped on the minimal dungeon floor. Hovering droopily beside Human Warlock, her ultra-cute round squishy floating purple Voidwalker with glowing starry lavender belly and golden wrist bracers sighs heavily in shared exhaustion.
